invariants.rationale: Option types should never be null per typical usage, so the result is not null.
The context is always passed as an argument and required to construct ScheduleCompactionActionExecutor.
A new ScheduleCompactionActionExecutor is always allocated before returning.
The returned value is always the result of scheduleLogCompactionExecutor.execute().
instantTime is expected to be a non-null, non-empty string as it is passed to the executor.
